research.research_brief: Evaluate compatibility of existing auth service with OIDC or SAML protocols for external federation. Identify necessary changes to web app authentication middleware and session management logic. Assess impact on user consent flows and data privacy compliance. Outline required updates for docs/auth.md regarding new login procedures.
research.prior_art: Common patterns for integrating third-party identity providers using OAuth 2.0/OIDC. Standard libraries provide pre-built handlers for token validation and user profile fetching. Existing enterprise solutions (e.g., Azure AD, Okta) offer documented integration guides for web applications. Security considerations include CORS configuration for callback endpoints and secure storage of refresh tokens.
